description: Welcome to the Llama Cookbook! This is your go to guide for Building with Llama: Getting started with Inference, Fine-Tuning, RAG. We also show you how to solve end to end problems using Llama model family and using them on various provider services

summary.one_liner: The official Llama Cookbook: a collection of guides, recipes and end-to-end examples for inference, fine-tuning, RAG and building applications with the Llama model family.
summary.what_it_does: The repository covers getting-started recipes for running Llama text and vision models, fine-tuning examples, and RAG reference code. It also includes end-to-end use-case projects spanning various domains. A folder of third-party provider integrations shows how to use Llama models through various provider services. The latest recipes focus on Llama 4, including the Llama API, a WhatsApp integration, long-context analysis with Llama 4 Scout, and research-paper and book analysis with Llama 4 Maverick. A src folder holds the original llama-recipes library and fine-tuning FAQs.
use_cases: Get started running Llama models for inference
Fine-tune a Llama model on custom data
Use Llama models through third-party provider services
notable: Covers Llama 4 recipes including 5M-token long context with Llama 4 Scout
Organized into 3P integrations, end-to-end use cases, getting-started references, and a src library folder
Includes a fine-tuning FAQ and a snapshot archive-main branch from before the repo refactor
caveats: Use of Llama models is governed by Meta's Llama license and Acceptable Use Policy for each model version
A recent refactor moved folders, so some older links may be broken; the archive-main branch holds the pre-refactor snapshot
